rows: - 24 Nov, opt-in CodeMirror timing (iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator, one development launch, one 17-character typing burst, no model). Buoy Console recorded 3,617 ms to hydrate the editor and 33 ms evaluating its bundle. Three input samples took 2–11 ms from `beforeinput` to CodeMirror update and 10–32 ms from update to the next WebView frame callback. The generated page bundle grows by 433 characters. Keep the development probe opt-in with a maximum of four reports per second and no document contents in the timing events.
